name: ButtonFilter
intent: Filter button that opens a dropdown: a label part and a square chevron part in one button. Shows how many filters are applied.
usage: Use ButtonFilter for filter controls above tables and lists, like Status or Owner. To open options, use DropdownMenu with trigger filter: it renders this button, passes open and count, and opens the menu from the whole button. The divider and chevron are visual. With no filters it looks like a quiet outline. With filters applied it turns blue and shows a Count of applied filters. See contracts/buttonfilter.json for the full contract.

size.note: Heights 28 / 36 / 44, same as Button. The chevron part is square.

open.note: Dropdown is open. Sets aria-expanded and turns the chevron.

count.note: Applied filters. Above 0 the button turns blue and shows a Count.

onClick.note: Whole button. DropdownMenu trigger=filter wires this for you.

useWhen: Filters above a table or list, like Status, Owner or Date.
A control that opens a list of options and shows how many are applied.
doNot: Do not invent a local split button, filter chip or dropdown trigger. Use DropdownMenu trigger=filter for the menu.
Do not use for page actions. Use Button.
Do not put more than one word or two in the label.
Do not show the count as text in the label. Pass count.
Do not wire the label and chevron to different actions. The whole button opens the dropdown.
a11y: One native button with aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded.
Its name is the filter name plus the count, like Status, 3 filters applied.
Focus ring around the whole button.
snippet: <DropdownMenu trigger="filter" label="Status" count={2} closeOnSelect={false} items={statusOptions} onSelect={toggleStatus} />

examples.title: No filters
examples.usage: The quiet default before anything is picked.

examples.title: Applied
examples.usage: Blue once one or more filters are picked. The Count shows how many.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: Match the size of the controls around it. The chevron part stays square.

examples.title: Open
examples.usage: While the dropdown is open the chevron turns up.
